cost_disclaimer: All cost figures are estimates computed at recorded peak cache-miss rates. They are not bills. When usage is complete (cost_complete=true) the figure is a conservative estimate under that rate assumption, but it is still not a hard upper bound on a bill: off-peak rates are about half and cache hits are cheaper. When usage is partial (cost_complete=false) the known subtotal covers only the rounds whose usage the server reported, and the direction of the bound on the full run's actual charge is unknown. Unknown usage is never treated as zero and is never imputed.

v2.note: The reported merged total is the unrounded sum rounded once. It is not equal to the sum of the two rounded arm values. Do not write '0.196013 + 0.044505 = 0.240517' — that exact equality is false. This is a display-rounding difference, not a billing difference.
